predecessors.name: Bengal Sultanate
predecessors.text: the Sultanate of Bengal, which the Hussain Shahi page says the dynasty ruled 'from 1494 to 1538'

successors.name: Sur Empire
successors.text: Bengal and Bihar, taken by Sher Shah Suri when Gaur fell on 6 April 1538

ledger.x: March 1534: Sher Shah Suri beats the sultan's forces 'at Battle of Surajgarh in March 1534'.
ledger.cp: Sher Khan Sur's Bihar (the Sur Empire from April 1538)

ledger.x: 1536-1537: Sher Shah took 'all lands west of the Teliagarhi pass': the page has the sultan holding the pass in 1536 and 'occupying all lands west of the Teliagarhi pass', and the sultan being 'forced to pay over 13,000,000 gold coins, and cede territory up to Sakrigali'.
ledger.cp: Sher Khan Sur's Bihar (the Sur Empire from April 1538)

ledger.x: 6 April 1538: the sultan was 'finally decisively defeated by Sher Shah Suri on 6 April 1538' and Gaur was sacked; the war ends with the whole sultanate in Sur hands.
ledger.cp: Sher Khan Sur's Bihar (the Sur Empire from April 1538)

wars.name: Sher Shah Suri's conquest of Bengal
wars.outcome: Surajgarh in March 1534; the Teliagarhi pass held in 1536; the lands west of it taken in 1536-37 with an indemnity of over 13,000,000 gold coins; Gaur sacked and the sultan finally defeated on 6 April 1538.

certainty.note: Neither page gives a boundary or an area; the Teliagarhi pass is the one frontier feature named (1536) and the Sakrigali cession is a name without a line.
